paths.title: GitHub intelligence
paths.summary: Read repository metadata, pinned manifests, releases and source changes.
paths.acceptance: Bounded pagination; conditional refresh; pinned file provenance; rate-limit tests.

paths.title: Diamond tool adapters
paths.summary: Discover compatible tools and datasets; map each to an existing bounded operation.
paths.acceptance: Licence/terms review; explicit target grant; no arbitrary shell; replayable receipts.

paths.title: Surface navigation
paths.summary: Deepen nested surfaces, spatial transitions and interchangeable identity lenses.
paths.acceptance: Keyboard and touch parity; reduced motion; context restored across every lens.

paths.title: Reciprocal event continuity
paths.summary: Preserve relationship changes and observations with versioned event references.
paths.acceptance: Inverse paths derive from one edge; correction/supersession; bounded replay without duplicated truth.

paths.title: Domain lenses
paths.summary: Represent maps, property, media and professional workflows over their own domain truth.
paths.acceptance: Same identities across lenses; explicit absent data; domain ownership and privacy retained.

paths.title: Agent interfaces
paths.summary: Expose bounded discovery/read/proposal contracts for tools and agents.
paths.acceptance: Typed I/O; capability limits; no promotion or execution implied by discovery.

paths.title: Federation transport
paths.summary: Connect accepted contracts to Atlas, Diamond and Swarm when real hosts and scoped credentials exist.
paths.acceptance: Verified authenticated roundtrip; expiry/revocation; idempotency; secrets server-only.

paths.title: SEQ Maps lens
paths.summary: Civic/map sources and descriptive traffic proof; synthetic first.
paths.acceptance: Read-only synthetic projection; source references; domain-owned truth; privacy and absence tests.

paths.title: Property lens
paths.summary: Long-lived property identity; private evidence never exported.
paths.acceptance: Read-only synthetic projection; source references; domain-owned truth; privacy and absence tests.

paths.title: Trade lens
paths.summary: Trade operator projections; no ratification of deferred Atlas extraction.
paths.acceptance: Read-only synthetic projection; source references; domain-owned truth; privacy and absence tests.

paths.title: Professional roles lens
paths.summary: Role/capability/source projections; no automatic credential or competence claims.
paths.acceptance: Read-only synthetic projection; source references; domain-owned truth; privacy and absence tests.

paths.title: Media / World Weaver lens
paths.summary: Transformation lineage, rights standing and protected-region evidence.
paths.acceptance: Read-only synthetic projection; source references; domain-owned truth; privacy and absence tests.

paths.title: Health lens
paths.summary: Synthetic continuity/consent views only; no clinical decisions or live health data.
paths.acceptance: Read-only synthetic projection; source references; domain-owned truth; privacy and absence tests.

paths.title: Software hubs lens
paths.summary: Repository/tool/database relationships and explicit compatibility observations.
paths.acceptance: Read-only synthetic projection; source references; domain-owned truth; privacy and absence tests.

paths.title: Physical interface research
paths.summary: Wearables, spatial interfaces and embodiment remain research. No hardware actuation.
paths.acceptance: Documented I/O boundary, safety/authority contract and display-only synthetic probe.
